classification: fixture-live acceptance stills; not a clean promotional recording

chapters.title_zh: 天朝特色 361 制：一期能力样例

status.zh: 能力演示，不是正式成片
status.en: CAPABILITY DEMO · NOT A RELEASE VIDEO

cues.zh: 欢迎来到天朝大厂：先校准，再发榜，最后解释这个 C 为什么是你。
cues.en: Welcome to the imperial megacorp: calibrate first, publish the board, then explain why the C is yours.

chapters.title_zh: 校准会：用最礼貌的语气，讨论最不礼貌的名额

status.zh: 验收夹具静帧；不代表干净连续录屏
status.en: FIXTURE-LIVE STILL · NOT A CLEAN CONTINUOUS RECORDING

cues.zh: 自动排名后、发榜前，玩家可以校准：直接公示，或在两个分档边界交换两个人。
cues.en: After automatic ranking and before publication, the player may calibrate: publish as-is or swap two officials across a grade boundary.

cues.zh: 你能抬末名 3.75，也能把末名 3.5 压进 3.25；每次动笔都有黑幕风险。
cues.en: You can lift the last 3.75 or push the last 3.5 into 3.25; every pen stroke carries scandal risk.

chapters.title_zh: 考核榜：终于有人告诉你到底排第几
chapters.title_en: SCOREBOARD: SOMEONE FINALLY TELLS YOU YOUR RANK

status.zh: 验收夹具静帧；数值仅作该证据的可见内容
status.en: FIXTURE-LIVE STILL · VALUES ARE LIMITED TO THIS EVIDENCE

cues.zh: 考核榜冻结人物、官职、KPI、价值观、名次、档位和连续次数，不是闪一下就没的通知。
cues.en: The board freezes officials, offices, KPI, values, rank, grade, and streak; it is not a disposable toast.

cues.zh: 最近一期榜单会冻结到下一次发榜，调任不会偷偷改写当期名单。
cues.en: The latest board stays frozen until the next publication, so a transfer cannot rewrite the current cycle.

chapters.title_zh: 3.25 不是表情包：上司告身与四重后果
chapters.title_en: 3.25 IS NOT A MEME: THE SUPERIOR'S RECEIPT

status.zh: 验收夹具静帧；不宣称申诉连续闭环
status.en: FIXTURE-LIVE STILL · NO CLAIM OF A COMPLETE APPEAL LOOP

cues.zh: 3.25 同时影响地方国库、个人金币、贤能和一年俸禄；组织说这是共同承担。
cues.en: A 3.25 hits the local treasury, personal gold, merit, and one year of salary; the organization calls it shared accountability.

cues.zh: 罚没保存精确金额和本轮编号，翻案退的是这次实际扣的钱。
cues.en: The penalty keeps exact amounts and the cycle serial; a reversal refunds what this cycle actually took.
